name: i-have-adhd
description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
one_liner: A plugin for AI coding assistants that forces them to answer straight — no rambling, no 'great question!' filler, just the next concrete step.
buyer: A freelance developer or small dev-team lead who bills by the hour and is tired of paying for AI assistant chatter instead of code.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools consultancy bundles it into a 'AI coding hygiene' onboarding package for client teams adopting Claude Code or similar.
A coding bootcamp installs it across student environments so beginners get short, numbered instructions instead of overwhelming AI essays.
An agency running AI-assisted freelance work standardizes on it to keep AI output consistent and fast to scan across many contractors.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'enterprise tuning' service that customizes the rule set for a company's internal coding standards.
Bundle it as part of a broader paid 'AI agent configuration pack' sold to dev teams.

steal_this: Package a small marketplace of these tone/behavior tweaks (ADHD-friendly, terse, verbose-for-juniors, etc.) as a $9 'agent personality pack' this weekend.
